project_type: Next.js 16.3.8 web server + Expo React Native mobile client, PostgreSQL + Prisma ORM, TypeScript monorepo
build_system: bun for server, expo for mobile. Server uses Next.js webpack mode. Mobile uses expo-sqlite for local cache.
test_framework: bun test for server-side unit tests (import from 'bun:test', not vitest or jest)
build_command: bun run build (runs prisma generate && next build --webpack)
test_command: bun test (runs tests in tests/ and lib/services/ directories)
verification_instructions: 1. Server changes: run 'bun dev' to start server on localhost:3000, test API endpoints with curl or mobile client. 2. Mobile changes: run 'bun dev' for server, then 'cd m && npx expo start' for mobile client, test on iOS/Android simulator or physical device. 3. Check server logs for errors. 4. Toggle light/dark mode in mobile app Settings to verify theme changes.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma generate produces node_modules/.prisma/client types. Not checked in. Run 'bunx prisma generate' after schema changes.
environment_constraints: Server runs on Windows with PowerShell. Mobile dev requires Expo dev client or Expo Go. Module access control enforced by AuthorizationService - guest users may have modules disabled. Leave module specifically throws errors for unauthorized guests.
contribution_requirements: Follow AI Constitution and .agents/rules/. Database safety: never hard delete on tables with deletedAt. Use soft deletes. Styling: use semantic tokens from theme/tokens, never hardcode colors. Mobile: use TrackerIcon component for icons, minimum 48px touch targets. Server APIs must return proper HTTP status codes (403 for authorization, not 500).
key_patterns: 1. API error handling: wrap assertUserModuleAccess in try/catch, return apiError with 403 status (see vault/journal routes). 2. Mobile theming: import { useTheme } from '@/theme/ThemeContext', destructure { colors }, use colors.text, colors.background, colors.coral, colors.primary, etc. instead of hex/rgba. 3. Icon resolution: ActivitySymbolBadge expects 'symbol' prop, resolves via symbol-registry.ts to emoji or TrackerIconName. 4. API response format: apiSuccess({ data }) or apiError(code, message, status).
directory_structure: app/api/mobile/v1/ - mobile API routes. lib/services/ - domain services. m/src/features/ - mobile feature screens. m/src/components/ - shared mobile components. m/src/theme/ - theme tokens and context. design-system/ - web components (not relevant for mobile). prisma/schema.prisma - database schema.
